note: T-GOL-03a. The approved activities a person can add to My Daily Routine. Placeholders only: {first_name}, {time}. A line is used only when every placeholder in it has a value. Invitations, never orders or guilt; about an 8th-grade reading level. Movement stays beginner or moderate; items marked movement are off by default, with 'Check with your clinician first', for people who said an activity limits them (FR-GOL-03). Not allowed in v2: fasting, calorie targets, weight loss, medication or supplements. Custom items (typed by the person) are never spoken: the coach says one of custom_lines and the label is shown as text only (FR-VOC-05). review_status: pending until the clinical team approves; prod uses approved only (dev may use pending). Templates: quick starts the person picks and then edits (movement items are left out for people whose activity is limited). Listed for review in REVIEW.md. spoken_name is said in the weekly review's routine win ("you made time for {spoken_name}").
